Results.ReviewText: It's been years since I've owned a gas grill because I always liked using charcoal. I was concerned that food wouldn't taste as good without charcoal but to my surprise it does with this gas grill. Oh and it gets really hot.

Results.ReviewText: I have owned three Weber grills in my lifetime. They are very reliable and dependable. If you ever need parts for your grill webber.com has everything you need.

Results.ReviewText: The grill is easy to use which is what we were looking for. We have a Weber kettle charcoal grill and love it too. But we wanted to be able to cook dinner during the week after getting home from work. This grill gives us that option.

I like this particular model because it is easy to get the propane tank in and out of the housing.
I would only consider buying Weber grills.

Results.ReviewText: I had a Weber Genesis grill for over 25 years and thought a new Weber was the obvious choice. I am disappointed with this model for several reasons.  It does NOT have a tank scale and apparently cannot be added. I have already had a tank run out and was stuck not being able to cook my dinner.  There is also a gap in between the drip pan and the front edge of the grill grates.  I had drippings all over the tank and inside the cabinet below - such a mess!  Now I have to make sure nothing is over top that area, limiting how much I can put on the grill.  I also have to be extra careful when turning the tank off - you can't just bend over and reach in - you have to squat down to reach in, so you don't burn your arm on the hot metal at the top of the cabinet.  I do a LOT of grilling throughout the year and assumed that the next Weber grill would be just as good as the last one.  It is NOT!
Results.Title: Disappointed!

Results.ReviewText: Very good grill cooks evenly but I should have bought the four burner grill
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: It's an ok grill which serves its purpose.  I just wish it had 4 wheels instead of just 2 which would make it easier to move around.
Results.Title: Weber - A Good Grill

Results.ReviewText:
New Weber Spirit is not built as solid as older model.  The handle on the lid gets extremely hot -need oven mit to open and close when grilling.  There are only 2 wheels as opposed to 4 wheels on older models and the bottom does not have solid back.

The sear area is terrific!  Also, the self starting burners are wonderful.  It is the perfect size for me,

Results.ReviewText: Have had the grill for about a month.  Love the sear zone have used it on every outing.  As my last Weber heat seems to be consistent across all three burners.  The natural gas is a dream, living in a condo no more lugging tanks.
Results.Title: Non Stop Grilling

Results.ReviewText: Very nice model but much rather go with EP-325. Better value and overall better quality with better parts. The wheels, stainless steel etc. I don’t think this model should honestly exist. The EP-325 should be standard. I didn’t see it at my local stores otherwise I would’ve gotten that one.
Results.Title: Very good but EP-325 is better value

Results.ReviewText: Excellent grill for the 2 of us. This is our first gas grill and we are having fun trying new things.
Results.Title: Just what we needed

Results.ReviewText: My current Spirit E-325 is a replacement from the one I initially purchased. The first one had an air flow problem which created sputtering and excessive burner noise. The second unit appears to operate somewhat better but I believe further adjustments need to be made. I have decided to live with it for now until I get a gas fitter to examine it more closely. / I have used this BBQ five times since new. Before submitting a review, I wanted to see how easy it was to clean. Yesterday I cleaned it for the first time. I would say Weber did a good job in designing the Spirit to for easy cleaning. Overall, I am pretty satisfied with my new Weber.
Results.Title: Well designed!

Results.ReviewText: This is a great propane grill for small spaces. It lights easy and burns well. I really wish I had paid more attention to other options though. This grill does not offer a griddle top that you can buy separately. After cooking on my friends griddle top I know feel I’m missing out. If this grill offered a griddle top it would be a 5 star option.

Results.ReviewText: The grill works well except if there is a wind or a gusty wind causing the flame to go out.  Weber Support attempted to get me to purchase an $82.00 gas line kit.  This to assure gas pressure was perfectly correct.  We have correct gas line pressure.  Weber also said to not grill in inclement weather such as when it’s windy.  I approached Weber with this issue and cited the back side off the grill is wide open, thinking if it had a rear cover it would block the wind.  Weber completely dismissed this notion.  I bought my first Weber gas grill in 1992 and through the years since.  NO LONGER!
Results.Title: In a wind my Spirit Gas Grill won’t stay lit!

Results.ReviewText: Only complaint is the grill grates. The spacing between is a little too big, some food falls through. Also, when I brush the grates, they bang back and forth inside the bbq shell, they’re a little small .

Results.Title: Great product very well designed and made!

Results.ReviewText:
Gave last Weber to my sister when moving from house to condo.  After 4 years decided it was time for a grill again.  Only considered a Weber.  Needed a smaller footprint (which this has when both trays are folded down when not in use), but also wanted enough power to grill for company and sear.  This one fits all my requirements.  The folding side trays are nicer and easier to use than my other one which now would be about 20 years old.  Like the fact that the gas tank is hidden inside the base and out of site but easy to get to, same with the drip tray.  The sear function does well!  Read the instructions though. Really like the thermometer inserted into the hood for temperature reading to co tell the heat when cooking.  Don’t think I’ve ever had that before.  

Not so thrilled about:
The metal hood is noticeably thinner than my OG from 1992. The handle which is used to lift the hood actually gets hot near the sides, when cooking at higher temps.   The Weber cover which I bought separately, has gone down in quality.  I leave my grill out, covered -year round.  I’m hoping this cover makes it two full years.  The others used to be  very substantial compared to this one.
Results.Title: Third Weber Gas Grill in 35 years

Results.ReviewText: We needed a compact grill with the ability to heat up quick. Love this grill!

I also added the griddle insert for this model. Great addition.  Hoping I get another 14-15 year from this grill.

I just wanted to upgrade to a newer model with upgraded features and found the Spirit E325 as a good replacement.The grill really heats up  fast and the Zear zone option is really good when cooking steaks..Another good feature is the sides fold down making it more compact for storage.I could not be happier with my choice.

Results.Title: Simple, Solid Grill

Results.ReviewText:
Recently purchased the Weber Spirit E-325 Liquid Propane gas grill.  This is my second Weber.  Assembly instructions were easy to follow and the parts are marked.  Quality is good and the grill works good. Heat distribution seems good.  Temperature gauge is an added plus.  The hooks on the sides of the shelves are too small to hang some grilling utensils.  Bigger hooks would be more versatile.   Securing the tank works but I feel Weber could have made something better?
Overall the grill works good.  Quality is good.  Price is higher than other grills of similar design.  Overall I would purchase again.
Results.Title: Weber makes a good grill
